title: AEX: AFK EXOS HEROES
summary: The tiniest adventure in the world begins! Place it anywhere on your desktop and watch your heroes battle automatically. Effortlessly enjoy a flood of loot and the thrill of progression.
about:
The world’s tiniest adventure begins!

A vast universe unfolding right above your taskbar.

Embark on a quest to find the lost Emperor's sword, 'Exestruk'!

<AEX: AFK EXOS HEROES> is a lightweight desktop idle turn-based RPG you can place anywhere on your monitor. Even while you work or multitask, your heroes never stop fighting.

Your Own Hero Squad, Quietly Perfected in the Corner of Your Screen

Simply leaving it in the corner of your PC screen is enough. In a desktop environment that never interrupts your daily work or web browsing, your heroes roam the battlefield on their own, endlessly sweeping up loot. Experience maximum sense of achievement without being tied down by playtime.

5vsN Turn-Based Strategy Where Synergy and Positioning Decide Victory

Features a turn-based combat system centered around building a 5-hero formation. Once you set up front and back row positioning and elemental affinities to neutralize enemies, battles unfold completely automatically. Your tactical design directly becomes your victory and progression speed.

Endless Loot and Unstoppable Progression

Vast amounts of gear and rare resources pour in as you clear stages. Rather than mere disposable items, equipment with unique stats and distinct value constantly fills your inventory. Harvest rewards accumulated over your idle time and savor the pure thrill of a great drop.

Greater Rewards Together: The Guild System

Form an alliance with comrades to clear Guild Dungeons. The stronger your bond, the stronger your heroes grow. Rare items obtainable only through Guild Dungeons will boost your progression speed to the next level.

The Stage to Prove the Ultimate Deck: Global Arena

Build your own 5-hero deck and compete against players from around the world. Break through your limits in intense battles where strategy decides the outcome, climb to the top of the leaderboards, and claim massive seasonal honor rewards.
